claims.title: Full-output trajectory TV accounting and resource-abort certificates

quoted_fields.interface: Basis input and complete computational-basis output of an open even square grid. Four disjoint matching layers cycle horizontal-even, horizontal-odd, vertical-even and vertical-odd. At each actual pair independently: D=(3I+4iZZ)/5 with probability 1-r-epsilon, QD with Q=(12I-5iXX)/13 and probability epsilon, or trace both qubits and replace by I/4 with probability r. Categories are state-independent; old reset outcomes, fresh preparation bits and all classical control are retained in the proof. Exact input, correct conditional physical instruments, normalized approximate states, canonical Schmidt weights relative to each precompression state, complete records and outcome-dependent control. Additional arithmetic/gate errors require separate bounds; adaptive representation choices are transcript-defined identities with correct physical-label maps.
quoted_fields.failure: Record-weighted full-output error does not bound arbitrarily postselected rare conditional states. Raw noncanonical singular-value loss is insufficient. Equal local SVD tolerances do not imply equal total error across representations. Dynamic outcome-dependent ordering may invalidate a flags-only future-operation count. A finite observed abort rate is not an upper bound without the specified confidence method and frozen independent sampling. Source-reported exact confidence arithmetic is not an independent audit. No efficient-rank distribution, general noisy-circuit sampler or speed advantage is established.
